title: I made this game coz I spent $50 on one of the top 10 phone games and I think i can do better
author: Danoz420
selftext:
I know this game aint anything special but I made it coz I wanted to play a game like this at the airport last month and every other game on the market sucked. I vibe coded this coz I think its lowkey fun and have played like 5 hours myself already haha. Specs below:

All footage is real in-game capture from Godot (Android, still in development).

**Disclosure:** most sprites are AI-generated and touched up by me. The rest come from free asset packs I found online. I'd rather be upfront.

**The idea:** Vampire Survivors-style auto-combat, mixed with the bite-sized stage progression of mobile games.

**What's in the game so far:**

* 6 heroes, each with a passive ability
* 5 maps, 87 monsters, 72 bosses
* 100 stages (+100 hard mode, still untested)
* Expedition, endless and training modes
* 20 run items (weapons, armour, trinkets)
* 205-node PoE-style talent tree
* 5 gear sets with tiers and set bonuses. Equipped gear shows on your hero in the menus and in game
* Smithing/forging to upgrade weapons from common to legendary
* 5 minigames: snake, block drop, darts, slots, fishing

**What I'd love feedback on:**

* Does the core loop look fun from the video?
* Is the UI readable on a phone screen?
* What would make you want to play it?

Any other feedback is welcome! If you want to hate on it, feel free lol, I'm just trying my best.

comments.author: Alexguitar11
comments.body: Looks cool. I'm making a sorta similar game but a more Gothic approach and only vfx animations. Looks a little slow for me though combat wise but that's just me. I do have a question for you. You plan to release on Google play? I can't find any testers for my game I released lol only. They require 12 for 14 days now no unistalls so kinda disappointed. Set everything up just to not be able to publish it except on itch
